rules.description: Customer not-as-described / item-not-received claim contradicted by retailer delivery truth. Observe only: claim event joins first-party false_nad with first-party merchant delivery/POD confirmation. Missing retailer signal means absent (fail-closed), never risky-because-silent. Human Promote required.

Synthetic or AI-faked receipt evidence contradicted by intact retailer checkout-session truth. Observe only: claim event joins first-party synthetic_receipt_evidence with first-party merchant checkout-session integrity. Missing retailer signal means absent (fail-closed), never risky-because-silent. Human Promote required.

Synthetic or AI-faked damage evidence contradicted by matching retailer payment/order record. Observe only: claim event joins first-party synthetic_damage_evidence with first-party merchant payment-record match. Missing retailer signal means absent (fail-closed), never risky-because-silent. Human Promote required.
